hypothesis: R163 aggregate budget degradation, relation-specific scoring, and Q08 primary-filing backfill will allow the immutable cohort to complete exactly once and satisfy all three product thresholds in one three-layer-live execution.

cohort.selection_rule: every frozen question exactly once on commit 0786757; no prior state, saved states, rerun, best-of, silent exclusion, or cross-candidate splicing

decision_rules.pass: The one merged exact-once artifact has 30/30 status=done, three-layer live fidelity, no saved states, evidence_reachable_rate >= 0.60, orphaned_sub_questions == 0, and false_premise_failed == 0.
decision_rules.candidate_passes: Publish this artifact as the sole product proof and proceed to provider-free F15; do not execute another full cohort.
decision_rules.candidate_fails: Preserve the complete failed experiment, classify defect classes, change code, and treat any later full cohort as another independent candidate; never splice cases or metrics.

power_and_noise.rationale: This is a census of the immutable acceptance cohort and a threshold decision, not an A/B effect estimate.
power_and_noise.judge_samples_rationale: Formal metrics are deterministic reader-delivery and behavioral measurements; one judge sample avoids irrelevant repeated judge variance.
power_and_noise.budget_coverage: R160 cost CNY 14.55970092 and R162 cost CNY 3.32336636; CNY 25 covers the expected census while retaining ample room under the CNY 300 plan fuse.

tavily_key_policy: Keep the configured key unless Tavily explicitly reports account quota exhaustion. Harness request-budget exhaustion, timeout, fetch degradation, or any other failure is not a switch trigger. Never persist either key in tracked or run artifacts.
stop_conditions: sum of the six shard ledgers reaches CNY 25
any shard reaches its CNY 5 fuse
credentials or third-party response bodies would leave ignored artifacts
a configuration error would violate exact-once, live-fidelity, or shard-ledger isolation before paid execution
rollback: Preserve every terminal and partial artifact, stop dependent paid work, and do not rerun, replace, or supersede a failed case on unchanged code.
